_comment: Corpus enumeration for the MCP Server Architecture Patterns paper (ICSME 2026 Industry Track). Two parts: (1) the 15-server taxonomy_corpus that the pattern catalog was derived from; (2) the 30 classification_examples used in the §5.1 classification experiment. ANSYR servers are anonymized as Server-A through Server-E for IP reasons; categories disclosed.

taxonomy_corpus._comment: The 15 independently developed MCP servers we coded to derive the pattern catalog (5 production ANSYR + 10 public).

ansyr_servers.category: telephony adapter (carrier/SIP integration with domain validation)
customer/CRM resource gateway (read user, account, history)
multi-tenant aggregator (proxies per-tenant downstream MCP servers)

classification_examples._comment: 30 server descriptions used in the §5.1 classification experiment. 6 per pattern. Mix of synthetic descriptions and abstractions of real servers. Classifier (Claude Haiku 4.5) sees only `name`, `tools`, `resources`, `description` — never `pattern`.

examples.name: filesystem-server
examples.description: Exposes local filesystem as structured resources with CRUD operations.

examples.name: postgres-server
examples.description: Translates database tables into addressable MCP resources.

examples.name: s3-resource-server

examples.name: browser-automation-server
